levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Two ideas from two different sources: the deck, an image search, or anywhere else. Each row names one specific feature taken and says where the load goes and how that feature handles it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both rows name a specific feature, but one reason is general ("it held a lot") rather than about the load path.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The designs are described in general terms, or only one row is complete.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: The table is empty, or both rows take from the same design.

criterion: Research: Two borrowed ideas, each specific and tied to where the load goes

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names a feature that uses the thickness direction, says where on the hook it goes, and says why there.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Names a feature but not where it goes or why.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Blank, or describes only a flat outline with no use of thickness.

criterion: Research: A 3D feature is named, placed on the hook, and justified

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Two photographed sketches of two genuinely different hooks, both readable, and at least one shows a 3D feature through a side view, a section, or shading.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.short: Two sketches, same idea or flat
levels.descriptor: Two sketches, but they are the same idea redrawn, or neither shows anything beyond a flat outline.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one sketch is in the photos, or one of the two cannot be read.

criterion: Concept Sketches: Two readable sketches of two different hooks, with a 3D feature shown

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both sketches are marked standard or multi-part, and each note states the idea and its 3D feature.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both notes are present, but one could describe any hook.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one sketch is typed and explained.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Neither sketch is typed or explained.

criterion: Concept Sketches: Each sketch is typed and its idea stated in one line
